notes.content:

[*] Dynamic enemy generation added with goblins and wolves spawning procedurally for varied gameplay.,

[*] Multiple new levels/environments: Town, Forest, Graveyard with smooth map transitions and loading logic.,
[*] Performance optimized via static lighting, asset cleanup; stable 60 FPS on test hardware; project size reduced.,
[*] Shooting system redesigned with arrow objects and Niagara VFX for visual impact.,
[*] Enemy AI enhanced with improved behavior, attack animations, visibility (colored models), and unstuck logic.,
[*] Player interaction features added: F-key interactions, teleportation via obelisks, and UI feedback on actions.,

[*] Cutscenes and memories system added; quests replaced with map-oriented story events.,

[*] Ability skill levels now shown on UI.,

[*] Final project adjustments for Balladrion and Steam packaging.
